title: AI Prompt: Do whatever it takes, I have no strategies. And here is the result after 3 days.
author: FromBitcoinWithLove
selftext: ![img](rb7hd9ndpy1i1 "I told my AI agent: You're on your own, you're free to do anything you like. And the results are in after 3 days. Will report back after one week from today.")

comments.author: AoideusWasBanned
comments.body: Curious what it ends up doing. I'd make it log the reason for every trade next to the fill, otherwise after a week you'll have a P&L and no idea if it was the idea or just the week.

replies.author: FromBitcoinWithLove
replies.body:

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: three closed trades in three days doesn't tell you much either way. the week I'd watch is the one after its first losing streak, since "do whatever it takes" prompts tend to start sizing up to win it back.

replies.author: FromBitcoinWithLove
replies.body: in this downtrend most entries expired unfilled, bro, that's why there were only 3 **closed trades filled in three days,** two hit take-profit and one hit stop-loss. it's still running untouched now. not sure if a losing streak would happen, but perhaps I could have a chance to see how it responds when the market changes from a downtrend to a recovery soon.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the unfilled entries tell you something too (it waited for a dip that never came). if you don't want to wait for the turn, run the same rules over a stretch that already had one, like April 2025, and watch what the stop does. I built Quantradin (quantradin.com) for that kind of check, it replays written rules on past prices with fake money.

replies.author: FromBitcoinWithLove
replies.body: I dont think that was case (it waited for a dip that never came), as you can see 2 TP came from short while 1 SL from long.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: fair, I read that wrong then, it's trading both sides. two shorts hitting TP in a downtrend is about what you'd want, and one long stopping out against the trend is a cheap lesson. if it keeps reaching for longs while price falls, that's where a trend filter earns its place.

comments.author: Due_Set_6523
comments.body: the real stats are gonna be whatever happens with those other 20 trades. need a 1 week update

replies.author: FromBitcoinWithLove
replies.body: The Autopilot runs continuously, making its own decisions about when to enter, exit, or simply wait. The 20 trades shown are just a snapshot of its performance for the last 3 days. I'll share an update after one week.
